title: Auto-Compaction & Live Context Management
scope: Map how OpenWorker prevents context-overflow corruption of LLM output via token-threshold-triggered compaction with retry-once + trim fallback, and live context injection.

compaction_config.threshold_pct: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_PCT — percentage of context window that triggers compaction
compaction_config.cap_tokens: DEFAULT_CAP_TOKENS — hard token cap for compacted output
compaction_config.keep_fraction: KEEP_RECENT_FRACTION — fraction of trigger tokens kept as recent context after compaction
compaction_config.model_setting: compaction_settings is a live getter — Settings changes apply without a rebuild of the TurnEngine

trigger_and_execution.check: _compaction_due() (engine.py:447) — cheap, side-effect-free check between iterations and before new turn
trigger_and_execution.signal: Uses turn.usage.context_tokens (from provider) or _compaction.estimate_tokens(outbound_messages) as fallback
trigger_and_execution.trigger: yield Event(COMPACTING, {}) BEFORE the slow summarizer call so surfaces show progress
trigger_and_execution.retry: Attempts _build() once, retries once (for _attempt in range(2)) — both modes
trigger_and_execution.failure_policy: attended → Retry/Trim prompt to user; unattended → auto-trim and continue (never park a run on bookkeeping)

overflow_recovery.catch: engine.py:363 — provider exception caught in _loop() try/except around _astream()
overflow_recovery.route: is_context_overflow(exc) + not _cancel.is_set() → yield COMPACTING, force=True compaction, continue loop
overflow_recovery.progress_guarded: Each pass moves the boundary forward or gives up — a model that keeps overflowing still terminates in the error path
overflow_recovery.partial_survives: streamed/streamed_reasoning are persisted as _partial_turn() message before the error path — what the user watched arrive survives the failure

live_context_provider.field: context_provider: Optional[Callable[[], str]] — set post-construction by the surface/manager
live_context_provider.injection: _outbound_messages() (engine.py:1125) appends ephemeral <system-context> block to LAST user message at send-time only (never persisted)
live_context_provider.purpose: Dynamic per-turn context (e.g. live directory list) rides on the latest user turn — can't reliably inject system messages mid-thread across providers
live_context_provider.strip: Display-only sidecars (source, _display, ts, reasoning, usage) are stripped from every outbound message — providers reject unknown keys

compaction_state_persistence.compaction_state: _compaction.CompactionState — persists the compacted block representation for replay
compaction_state_persistence.outbound_view: apply_to_outbound() replaces everything before the boundary with the compacted summary, keeping the tail intact — byte-stable between turns so prompt caching works
compaction_state_persistence.stale_reset: self._last_context_tokens = None after compaction — stale once outbound view shrank

ai_factory_compaction.compaction_gate: compact_memory_gate (factory/infra/_loopguard.py:834) — cross-turn gate prepends bounded history; calls keep_memory agent (factory/infra/tools_memory.py:53) + summarizer fallback (_compact_memory_fallback at line 801)
ai_factory_compaction.token_budget: maybe_compact (factory/infra/_loopguard.py:662) — token-budget trigger at 60% of compact_at_fraction from COMPACTION_CONFIG (factory/infra/control.py:559); uses estimate_tokens (line 647) on agent_msgs
ai_factory_compaction.threshold_constants: CONTEXT_COMPACT_CEILING (line 739) = PerRoleConfig hard_max; CONTEXT_COMPACT_FLOOR (line 821) — fails loudly if compacted dump still violates floor
ai_factory_compaction.invocation_site: agent.py:419 — run_with_loopguard checks estimate_tokens(prior_history) > CONTEXT_COMPACT_CEILING before each turn, calls compact_memory_gate
ai_factory_compaction.pre_tier_compaction: pipeline.py:813 — compact_context_if_needed (factory/infra/context.py:371) compresses run_brief at 100K token threshold before tier attempt
ai_factory_compaction.overflow_catch: _loopguard.py:419 — catches ModelHTTPError + UsageLimitExceeded, triggers RECOVER (tools=[]) but does NOT catch provider context-window overflow; no auto-compaction retry loop
ai_factory_compaction.scrub_pattern: _scrub_old_read_returns (factory/infra/_loopguard.py:210) — existing read-return scrub pattern that could be extended to overflow recovery

findings.gap_vs_ai_factory: ai-factory's compact_memory is triggered by token estimate via LiteRouter response, but has NO retry-once + trim fallback for unattended runs, and NO live context_provider injecting <system-context> into the latest user message. Context overflow crashes the LLM (produces garbage) instead of recovering.

proposal: ai-factory's context compaction (compact_memory in _loopguard.py) triggers on token estimate but has no fallback when the summarizer fails. When the LLM context overflows, the model produces garbage/hallucination instead of recovering. OpenWorker's pattern: (1) COMPACTING signal before summarizer so surfaces show progress, (2) retry-once + trim fallback for unattended runs, (3) live context_provider injecting <system-context> into the last user message at send-time. This should be adopted to prevent context-overflow from corrupting LLM output.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.pattern: Pydantic-AI before_model_request hook + ModelRetry for retry-once compaction — emit COMPACTING signal, attempt summarizer once, fall back to trim, never let context overflow corrupt output.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.code:
from pydantic_ai import Agent, hooks
from pydantic_ai.hooks import BeforeModelRequestEvent, RunContext

class CompactionState(BaseModel):
    boundary_idx: int
    summary: str

@agent_harvester.hook_impl
async def compact_on_overflow(ctx: RunContext) -> None:
    '''Before each model request, check token budget and compact if needed.'''
    tokens = ctx.usage.total_tokens
    if tokens > THRESHOLD_PCT * ctx.state.context_window:
        # Signal before slow summarizer
        emit_signal('compacting')
        state = await asyncio.to_thread(build_compaction, ctx.messages)
        if state is None:  # summary failed
            if ctx.is_attended:
                raise ModelRetry('Context compaction failed — retry')  # prompt user
            else:
                trim_oldest(ctx.messages)  # auto-trim, continue
        else:
            ctx.messages[:] = apply_compaction(ctx.messages, state)
        ctx._last_context_tokens = None  # reset for next check
pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: ai-factory's LLMs produce garbage when context overflows because compaction has no fallback — the summarizer fails silently and the model keeps going with bloated context. OpenWorker's engine.py:363-374 proves that catching context-overflow, yielding a COMPACTING signal, and forcing trim-on-failure recovers the turn instead of corrupting output. This is the kimi-cli KC-07 harness gap: _run_verify_edit (CC=49) exhausts budget, and compaction doesn't recover.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: ai-factory's auto-compaction lands in factory/infra/_loopguard.py — compact_memory_gate (line 834) runs the keep_memory summarizer agent with NO retry-once + trim fallback for unattended runs (only fails loudly via _compact_memory_fallback at line 801); maybe_compact (line 662) triggers on token estimate from COMPACTION_CONFIG (control.py:559) but has no COMPACTING event emission before the summarizer. The token-scrub pattern _scrub_old_read_returns (line 210) exists for read returns but NOT for context overflow. ModelHTTPError/UsageLimitExceeded caught at line 419 triggers RECOVER (tools=[]) but does NOT catch provider context-window overflow — the LLM keeps generating garbage. compact_context_if_needed (factory/infra/context.py:371) pre-compacts run-briefs at 100K tokens with a bare summarizer, no trim fallback. When _run_verify_edit (factory/infra/pipeline.py:429, 157 lines) exhausts budget, there is no BeforeModelRequest hook to intercept and compact. Adopt: (1) BeforeModelRequest hook wrapping maybe_compact with ModelRetry, (2) trim-on-fallback for unattended runs, (3) COMPACTING event emission before summarizer via factory/infra/exchange.py:149 mark_compaction, (4) live context_provider injecting <system-context> into last user message.
